# one JSON line: cancel job 2098965, then lower the memory request of the rome template (backup kept)
function esc(s)
    s = replace(s, "\\" => "\\\\", "\"" => "\\\"", "\n" => "\\n", "\r" => "", "\t" => "\\t")
    return "\"" * s * "\""
end
function run_out(cmd)
    out = IOBuffer(); err = IOBuffer()
    try
        run(pipeline(ignorestatus(cmd), stdout = out, stderr = err))
    catch e
        return "ERROR: " * sprint(showerror, e)
    end
    return String(take!(out)) * (position(err) > 0 ? "\n[stderr]\n" * String(take!(err)) : "")
end
parts = Pair{String,String}[]
work = get(ENV, "WORK", "")
push!(parts, "WORK" => work)
push!(parts, "scancel" => run_out(`scancel 2098965`))
cands = [joinpath(work, "skill-julia-cuda-jacc", "reference"), joinpath(work, "skill-slurm-julia-cuda-jacc", "reference"), "/scratch/coop/drozda/skill-slurm-julia-cuda-jacc/reference", "/scratch/coop/drozda/skill-julia-cuda-jacc/reference"]
dir = ""
for c in cands; isdir(c) && (dir = c; break); end
push!(parts, "dir" => dir)
push!(parts, "ls" => dir == "" ? "no reference dir found among: " * join(cands, " ") : join(readdir(dir), "\n"))
f = joinpath(dir, "run_job_cpu_parallel_rome.sbatch")
if dir != "" && isfile(f)
    txt = read(f, String)
    push!(parts, "before" => join(filter(l -> startswith(l, "#SBATCH"), split(txt, "\n")), "\n"))
    old = "#SBATCH --mem=240G"
    if count(old, txt) == 1
        cp(f, f * ".bak-20261126"; force = false)
        write(f, replace(txt, old => "#SBATCH --mem=100G"))
        push!(parts, "edit" => "changed 1 line, backup " * f * ".bak-20261126")
        push!(parts, "after" => join(filter(l -> startswith(l, "#SBATCH"), split(read(f, String), "\n")), "\n"))
    else
        push!(parts, "edit" => "no edit: the line '#SBATCH --mem=240G' was found $(count(old, txt)) times")
    end
else
    push!(parts, "edit" => "template not found in dir '$dir'")
end
sleep(2)
push!(parts, "squeue_user" => run_out(`squeue -u drozda -o "%.10i %.12P %.24j %.2t %.10M %R"`))
println("{" * join(["$(esc(k)):$(esc(v))" for (k, v) in parts], ",") * "}")
